a_busy_behavior: Every write open carries the DSN pragma busy_timeout(5000) (substrate.go Open): a statement blocked by another writer waits up to 5 seconds, then returns the driver's SQLITE_BUSY error, which each path classifies through its own error path (classify/Domainf). No process-level wait exists.
e_exit_codes: CLI contract: 0 success, 1 domain rejection, 2 usage or environment error. Coded domain errors carry their code in the JSON envelope {"error":{"code","message"}}; uncoded domain refusals classify as "domain-rejection"; usage/environment refusals classify as "usage".
